rationale: Adds show_menu_async, an anchored asynchronous native menu with submenus, check marks, per-row text colour and a minimum width taken from the anchor, opened from a common-mode timer and closed when its MainThreadScope dies, plus build_native_menu so the NSMenu structure is checkable. It also fixes the synchronous PopupMenu, whose rows had no target and so could never report a selection. Host-neutral and free of view or render dependencies, so the next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
